name: returning_customer_recall_past_order
description: Returning customer says 'I want to order more of what I got last time' and the AI should recall the past order details and facilitate a repeat order.

messages.text: My name is Linda, can I get a quote for 40 sheets of grey melamine chipboard 16mm
I want to order more of what I got last time

expected_behaviors.description: AI should address the customer as 'Linda' and reference the previous order

notes: Tests order recall: the customer wants to repeat a previous order. The AI should retrieve the prior quote/order (grey melamine chipboard 16mm) and either confirm the repeat order or ask for clarification on quantity, while addressing them by name.
